test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
With reference to the "Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet" mentioned in the context of Union Budget 2026-27, consider the following statements:

1. The scheme has an approved financial outlay of ₹7,280 crore.

2. It aims to establish 6,000 metric tonnes per annum of integrated rare earth permanent magnet manufacturing capacity in India.

Which of the statements given above is/are *CORRECT*?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **While presenting the Union Budget 2026-27, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the government's focus on rare earth processing, building on the scheme launched in November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** The government had earlier approved the Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnet with a **financial outlay of ₹7,280 crore**.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct:** The scheme aims to establish **6,000 metric tonnes per annum** of integrated rare earth permanent magnet manufacturing capacity in India.
 
• The scheme covers the **entire value chain** from rare earth oxides to finished magnets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• New Proposals (Budget 2026-27)__

 
 
• **Rare Earth Corridors:** Support proposed for mineral-rich states including **Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu** to establish dedicated rare earth corridors.
 
• **High-Tech Tool Rooms:** Proposal to set up tool rooms by central public sector enterprises at two locations for designing and manufacturing high-precision components.
